name: Divisions
overview: Scripture clearly reveals that divisions within the church are a sign of a carnal spirit and are condemned as unbecoming for believers. The apostle Paul urges believers to avoid those who cause divisions and offenses contrary to the doctrine they have received, highlighting the seriousness of such strife. Jesus prayed fervently for the unity of His followers, desiring that they be one just as He is one with the Father, so that the world may recognize His divine mission and love. The presence of contentions and factionalism, as seen in the Corinthians claiming allegiance to different leaders, stands in opposition to the unity and purpose Christ intended for His church.
